## Change and scope

Describe the problem, resulting change and affected product/engineering boundaries.

## Decision status

Identify APPROVED requirements, PROPOSED choices and PENDING team decisions. Link relevant docs.

## Verification

Describe checks performed and remaining limitations. Include `git diff --check` and secret/artifact review; list application checks only when available.

- [ ] Existing and unrelated work preserved

- [ ] Scope and decision documentation updated where needed
